parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When calling this operation over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
When appending the token, use crop_token=value instead

在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value 替代
